name: ding
description: Open source self-hosted changelog widget for your web app.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ding/widget && npm run build -w @ding/dashboard && npm run build -w @ding/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,dashboard,widget -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @ding/server" "npm run dev -w @ding/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @ding/widget"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ding/server && npm run test -w @ding/widget
